warehouse/30316.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: Welcome! Our Iron Gate Guild can safely store and deliver your items even during wartime. You can recover anything you deposit at any time, so don't worry.

warehouse/30316-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: I teach Dwarven Fighters, Scavengers, and Bounty Hunters only. If you are an Artisan, please go to a Blacksmith.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30316-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: What, this envelope? It can't be... After so long, and now...? Oh, my... Please forgive me. It was a thoughtless mistake by my brother when he was young. I apologize for him. Please forgive us this one time.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30316-04.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: Have you met my brother? He can be found near the harbor . If you give him the wine that I gave you, he will answer your questions.
when: state STARTED; has items 2703,2706,2713; lacks items 2704

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30316-05.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: I didn't realize that my brother had stolen such an important thing... By all means, I shall pray for you to find the rest of the Scriptures of Knowledge.
when: state STARTED; has items 2703,2706,2705; lacks items 2704,2706,2713

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30316-01.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: What? This takes the place of the debt? This is not even a tenth of what he borrowed from me! Hmm... I f you do one favor for me on behalf of that sneak, then I will consider the debt repaid. What do you think?

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30316-04.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: Torai said he was going to Dragon Valley . He speaks with an accent because he lives in the country, so you will be able to recognize him. I hope he is safe... Phew... Thank goodness.
when: state STARTED; has items 1644; lacks items 1657; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30316-05.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: The rascal has already arrived. Thank you. Hey, that's my wife's prized possession, taken by Torai! Give that here! Phew! Anyway, since you did the job, I will keep my promise. Here is the mark of the scavenger. Take this to Warehouse Chief Moke to change profession to Scaven…
when: state STARTED; has items 1645; lacks items 1657,1644; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

I have been suffering from bad dreams for the last couple of nights. Every night an old man appears and demands that I give the scripture to the person who brings this envelope. First I thought it was just a sill…

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30316-03.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: You will find my brother near the harbor . He drinks there everyday. If you go and mention my name he will talk to you.

Q00417_PathOfTheScavenger/30316-02.html.text: Warehouse Keeper Raut: Good, I like your frankness. Actually, I have a nuisance of a nephew. One day the rascal was teased by his friends because he had bluffed that he could sell items to the monsters of Dragon Valley . And then the next day, he left with everything in the warehouse!
